movies.title: Gladiator
movies.overview: A betrayed Roman general rises through the gladiator arena to confront the corrupt emperor who destroyed his family.

review.body: Ridley Scott's swords-and-sandals epic remains the benchmark for modern historical action. Crowe carries the film with wounded gravitas, and the Colosseum sequences still thunder two decades later.

movies.title: Memento
movies.overview: A man with short-term memory loss tattoos clues on his body to hunt his wife's killer, told in reverse chronology.

movies.title: Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon

movies.tagline: The most acclaimed martial-arts film ever made.

movies.title: X-Men

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
movies.originalTitle: The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
movies.overview: A young hobbit inherits a ring of terrible power and sets out with eight companions to destroy it in the fires of Mount Doom.
movies.tagline: One ring to rule them all.

review.body: Jackson's opening chapter is blockbuster filmmaking with a soul. From the Shire's warmth to the Mines of Moria's dread, it balances spectacle and heart like few films since.

movies.title: Harry Potter and the Philosopher's Stone

movies.tagline: The greatest fairy tale never told.

movies.title: The Fast and the Furious

movies.tagline: Live life a quarter mile at a time.

movies.title: Spider-Man

movies.tagline: With great power comes great responsibility.

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers

movies.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King

movies.overview: The final battle for Middle-earth rages as Frodo and Sam reach the fires of Mount Doom.
movies.tagline: The eye of the enemy is moving.

movies.title: Pirates of the Caribbean: The Curse of the Black Pearl

movies.tagline: You can erase someone from your mind.

movies.overview: An elderly man reads a love story from a notebook to a fellow nursing-home resident.

King Leonidas and 300 Spartans make a legendary last stand against the Persian army at Thermopylae.

movies.title: Transformers

review.body: A superhero film that transcends its genre entirely. Ledger's Joker is a force of nature, and Nolan stages set pieces, from the truck flip to the hospital demolition, with surgical precision.
review.verdict: The definitive comic-book film, and one of the best films of its decade.

movies.title: Iron Man
movies.overview: Billionaire genius Tony Stark builds a powered suit of armor after being kidnapped in Afghanistan.
movies.tagline: Heroes are not born. They are built.

movies.title: WALL-E

movies.tagline: After 700 years of doing what he was built for, he will discover what he was meant for.

movies.title: Slumdog Millionaire
movies.overview: A Mumbai street kid is accused of cheating on a game show, and his life story explains every answer.
movies.tagline: What does it take to find a lost love?

movies.title: Avatar
movies.overview: A paraplegic Marine bonds with the Na'vi people of Pandora through an alien avatar body, and switches sides.

review.body: Cameron built a world you can feel. The story is familiar, but the immersive craft and emotional sincerity made it a generation-defining theatrical experience.
review.verdict: A landmark of immersive blockbuster cinema.

movies.title: Inglourious Basterds

movies.tagline: Your mind is the scene of the crime.

review.body: Nolan turns dream logic into heist mechanics, staging zero-gravity hallway fights and folding cities with practical bravado. A blockbuster that trusts its audience completely.
review.verdict: A rare blockbuster that is both a puzzle and a thrill ride.

movies.title: The Social Network

movies.tagline: You do not get to 500 million friends without making a few enemies.

movies.title: Toy Story 3

review.verdict: An ambitious, emotionally overwhelming sci-fi epic.
